units.source_text: 大竹七段只谈这点，不至于失慎泄露出去，让对方估摸到棋局。

en.t: Otake Seventh Dan spoke only about this point, so there was no danger that he would carelessly let something slip and allow the other side to guess the state of the game.

units.source_text: 只要从七段的房间传来这种电话声，我就不能不对他怀有好感。

en.t: Whenever that kind of telephone call came from the Seventh Dan's room, I could not help feeling well disposed toward him.
